statement: ∀ (x : YuiEucl n), Isometry (YuiSnoc x) → ∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a ((YuiSnoc x) '' YuiI) = 0
proof:
intro x hi a ha
classical
let U : ∀ N : ℕ, Fin N → Set (YuiEucl (n+1)) := fun N j =>
  (YuiSnoc x) '' Set.Icc ((j : ℝ) / N) (((j : ℝ) + 1) / N)
have hd : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ∀ j : Fin N, Metric.ediam (U N j) = 1 / (N : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  intro N hN j
  exact @yui_aux_0003 n E h_H002 h_T002 h_T003 h_T005 x hi N hN j
have hmesh : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => 1 / (N : ℝ≥0∞)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  simpa only [one_div] using ENNReal.tendsto_inv_nat_nhds_zero
have hdiam : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ j : Fin N, Metric.ediam (U N j) ≤ 1 / (N : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN j
  exact (hd N (by omega) j).le
have hcover : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (YuiSnoc x) '' YuiI ⊆ ⋃ j : Fin N, U N j := by
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
  exact @yui_aux_0006 n E h_H002 h_T002 h_T003 h_T005 x N (by omega)
have hcost : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ j : Fin N, (Metric.ediam (U N j)) ^ a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  apply (@yui_aux_0005 n E h_H002 h_T002 h_T003 h_T005 a ha).congr'
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
  simp only [hd N (by omega), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
apply le_antisymm ?_ zero_le
calc
  MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a ((YuiSnoc x) '' YuiI) ≤
      Filter.liminf (fun N : ℕ => ∑ j : Fin N, (Metric.ediam (U N j)) ^ a) Filter.atTop :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure_le_liminf_sum a _ _ hmesh U hdiam hcover
  _ = 0 := hcost.liminf_eq

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  E.Nonempty →
    ((∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (a : ℝ),
          0 < a →
            YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
              (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
                (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                  (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧ (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
            ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
            (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
              (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
                LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
        ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
          ∀ (x : YuiEucl n),
            Isometry (YuiSnoc x) → ∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) (YuiSnoc x '' YuiI) = 0
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
